blocks.text: Is hisse mein hum statistical models ke basic building blocks (bunyadi hisse) dekhenge: models ki qismein, woh kaise banaye jate hain aur un ki performance (kitna achha kaam karte hain) kaise check ki jati hai. Concepts aasan banane ke liye asal zindagi ki misalein bhi dekhenge.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein kaunse teen models sikhaye gaye hain?
blocks.explanation: Linear regression, logistic regression aur K-means clustering.

items: Statistical models: qismein, banana aur check karna.
